title: Koszul-regular, H_1-regular and quasi-regular immersions of spaces are stable under flat base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For any of the three regularity flavours, base changing an immersion i : Z -> X of spaces along a flat X' -> X preserves the flavour — the slogan the author retains above the statement (Regular immersions are stable under flat base change). The retained proof is written as the definitional transfer: each flavour is defined etale-locally by its scheme-theoretic meaning (Definition definition-regular-immersion, together with the flat-morphism definition section of Morphisms of Spaces for the hypothesis), and the schemes theorem Divisors, lemma flat-base-change-regular-immersion (regular/Koszul/quasi-regular sequences remain so after flat extension of rings) applies verbatim on charts. Retained author proof at lines 10595-10602.
